P01.reason: Whole-component dictionary has four bodies and five rings; six examples reference component IDs. The underlying 203 block assets are separate.

P02.reason: Mesh bounds checked in CPU tests and all six assemblies viewed from front, side, below and oblique. Panes are never stretched or tipped; the upright frame becomes thin edge-on. P03.reason: Original 160 pane states remain inspectable; importer tests pass. Whole-component assembly derives actual NESW states from adjacent cells, including changed arms when the body is absent.

P04.reason: Mixed panes and full glass share the same eight cells and palette. Native tests cover clear/tinted alpha, opaque depth, and submission-order invariance for all six assemblies.

P05.reason: Texture and original alpha come from imported assets. Emission remains per-block metadata; moss and coloured glass have no intrinsic emission. Shared light formula is unchanged.

P06.reason: Gray and clear sectors visibly interrupt the continuous pink outline on identical cells. Their physical mesh bounds remain 2.125 x 1 x 2.125 blocks. Viewed on dark and neutral backgrounds and below.

P07.reason: Native texture fidelity tests passed; luminous and unlit bodies shown beside an unscaled unit cube. Large casing remains a visibly cubic grid of glass borders.
